name: button
useFor: Use one primary action per section. Pair it with secondary (Get started, then Read the docs); ghost in toolbars; on-brand only on a rare blue band. Wire an onClick handler, use type="submit" for forms, or use asChild with a link for navigation.
constraints: Two blue keys side by side for equal actions
A gradient or glow on a key
A drop shadow under a key
A key that sinks or lifts on press
title: Button
description: Flat keys for primary, secondary and toolbar actions.
